name: EVE-JONG
source:
Private detective Kojiroh Amagi was playing mahjong as usual when he realized that there were not enough tiles. A girl standing next to him handed him one tile. But when Kojiroh tried to talk to her, another guy appeared, took away the girl and suggested to forget everything seen just now.
It was the beginning of a series of horrific events and card battles.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-july-2008-kara-no-shoujo.html]vndbreview[/url]]
